title: [v0.92.1][CORP-C] Route operational hardening to sidecar
body:
Part-Of #532

## Summary

Correct the #497 / Sprint 4 truth model after operator scope clarification: corporate IP-transfer acceptance is complete for #497, while broader post-move-in operational control-plane hardening is tracked separately in sidecar #624 and does not block Sprint 4 closeout.

## What changed

- Created sidecar issue #624 for GitHub/CI authority hardening, DNS/certificate ownership and rollback readbacks, AWS account guardrails, private custody receipt, and deployment rollback readback.
- Updated live #497 through typed issue update so its closed issue body records IP-transfer acceptance and routes operational hardening residuals to #624.
- Updated live Sprint umbrella #532 through typed issue update: membership version 5, #497 accepted/closed, #498 active, #624 nonblocking sidecar.
- Updated repo evidence and acceptance records so #497 has `blocked_actions: []`, `sidecar_issue: 624`, and `issue_ready_to_close: true` while still preserving all hardening gaps as truthful sidecar evidence.
- Repaired #497 SOR through typed `csdlc-edit apply` so it no longer says #497 remains non-terminal because of sidecar hardening.

## Validation

- `ruby .csdlc/evidence/497/validate-readiness.rb` passed with `blocked_actions: 0`, `sidecar_issue: 624`, `sidecar_actions: 7`, and `issue_ready_to_close: true`.
- `csdlc-doctor --repo /Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-issue-497-sprint4-sidecar-closeout --issue 497` passed.
- `csdlc-validate --root /Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-issue-497-sprint4-sidecar-closeout issue --issue 497` passed.
- `ruby -rjson -e 'ARGV.each { |p| JSON.parse(File.read(p)) }' ...` passed for the touched CORP-C/control-transfer/prepared JSON surfaces.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.

## Non-claims

- This PR does not complete #624.
- This PR does not complete #498.
- This PR does not close the Sprint 4 umbrella.
- This PR does not perform AWS, DNS, certificate, GitHub administration, billing, custody, or deployment mutation.
head: codex/497-sprint4-sidecar-closeout
